ROMEOSON MIKEFIELD NOVEMBERFIELD

Incident page for this loss

Name: WO1 Mikefield Novemberfield Romeoson
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: HHC 1 BDE 101 ABN
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 07/04/1969; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Army; reserve component; AV branch
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: OH-6A tail number 66-07812
Short Summary: Blew up in mid-air, probably from a phosphorus grenade; grenades were carried in glass jars with the pins pulled.
Location: Quang Tin Province I Corps.
Primary cause: Hostile Fire
Vehicle involved: helicopter
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
